ui_texts.noResults: Sorry, I couldn't find an answer to that question. 😔

one-tap-link-checkbox.label: One-click links:
one-tap-link-checkbox.question: How does the One-click links setting work?
one-tap-link-checkbox.answer: When enabled, links are shown in the board view of notes. When disabled, links are available only when opening the note. Find this setting in Settings.

remind-board-checkbox.label: Show board Reminders:
remind-board-checkbox.question: What is the Reminders board?
remind-board-checkbox.answer: The Reminders board shows all notes that have reminders set. It is shown by default, but you can hide it from Settings.

all-board-checkbox.label: Show board All:
all-board-checkbox.question: What is the All board?
all-board-checkbox.answer: The All board shows notes from all boards in one place. It is useful for a quick overview. It is disabled by default, but you can show it from Settings.

show-photos-board-checkbox.label: Board With Photos:
show-photos-board-checkbox.question: What is the With Photos board?
show-photos-board-checkbox.answer: The With Photos board shows only notes that have attached photos. Useful for quick access to notes with images. It is disabled by default, but you can show it from Settings.

show-videos-board-checkbox.label: Board With Video:
show-videos-board-checkbox.question: What is the With Video board?
show-videos-board-checkbox.answer: The With Video board shows only notes that contain attached video files. Useful for quick access to notes with videos. It is disabled by default, but you can show it from Settings.

show-sounds-board-checkbox.label: Board With Sounds:
show-sounds-board-checkbox.question: What is the With Sounds board?
show-sounds-board-checkbox.answer: The With Sounds board shows only notes that contain attached audio files. Useful for quick access to notes with audio recordings. It is disabled by default, but you can show it from Settings.

show-other-board-checkbox.label: Board Other Attachments:
show-other-board-checkbox.question: What is the Other Attachments board?
show-other-board-checkbox.answer: The Other Attachments board shows notes with attached files that are not photos, videos, or audio (e.g. documents, PDFs, etc.). You should keep in mind that photos not taken from a note in Multinotes but are attached as documents will appear in With photos board.

weekly-calendar-checkbox.label: Weekly calendar view:
weekly-calendar-checkbox.question: How to use the weekly calendar?
weekly-calendar-checkbox.answer: This is the default calendar view. If you prefer the monthly view, uncheck Weekly calendar view in Settings. You can switch between monthly and weekly view for a more detailed view of the notes. The calendar can be set as the start board, so that when opening the application you get a view of your tasks for the week/month

show-datemod-checkbox.label: Show modification/calendar date:
show-datemod-checkbox.question: How to show the modification date of notes?
show-datemod-checkbox.answer: Go to Settings and check Show modification/calendar date. This will show the creation/last modification date. For notes placed in the calendar, the calendar date will be shown. For notes that have reminders, the set reminder time will be shown on the right.

show-time-checkbox.label: Show modification/calendar date:
show-time-checkbox.question: How to show the reminder time?
show-time-checkbox.answer: Go to Settings and check Show modification/calendar date. For notes that have reminders, the set reminder time will be shown on the right.

img-bgrd-checkbox.label: Graphical background:
img-bgrd-checkbox.question: What does the Graphical background setting do?
img-bgrd-checkbox.answer: This setting is enabled by default. When a note is opened, its content is shown on a graphical background. This makes notes visually more appealing. If you prefer a simpler view, you can uncheck it and a plain color background will be used.

show-board-note-count-checkbox.label: Notes count in board:
show-board-note-count-checkbox.question: How to see how many notes are in each board?
show-board-note-count-checkbox.answer: Go to Settings and check Notes count in board. This will show the number of notes in brackets next to the name of each board. Exceptions are aggregate boards like All, With Photos etc. By default this setting is disabled then the number of notes in the active board can be seen in the counter in the header.

note-font-size-input.label: Note Font Size:
note-font-size-input.question: How to change the font size in notes?
note-font-size-input.answer: Go to Settings and select a size from Note Font Size. This changes the text size in the notes themselves.

modal-font-size-input.label: Modal Font Size:
modal-font-size-input.question: How to change the font size when viewing a note?
modal-font-size-input.answer: Go to Settings and select a size from Modal Font Size. This changes the text size when you open a note for full view.

scaleSlider.label: Zoom:
scaleSlider.question: How to change the zoom level of the application?
scaleSlider.answer: Go to Settings and use the Zoom slider (25%-175%). The Settings window becomes semi-transparent so you can monitor the result. If the currently active board has many notes, this may cause a delay in the process, so it is preferable to choose a board with fewer notes when making the setting. You can also enter an exact value for fine tuning, then press Confirm to apply the change.

order-checkbox.label: Order notes:
order-checkbox.question: How to order notes?
order-checkbox.answer: Check Order notes in Settings and choose criteria - by number, color, creation/modification date, calendar date, or alphabetically. You can also set reverse order - for example, if sorting by date, you will see the newest notes at the beginning.

sort-criteria-numord.label: by number
sort-criteria-numord.question: How to sort notes by number?
sort-criteria-numord.answer: Go to Settings, check Order notes and select by number. Notes will be sorted in the order they were created.

sort-criteria-color.label: by color
sort-criteria-color.question: How to sort notes by color?
sort-criteria-color.answer: Go to Settings, check Order notes and select by color. Notes will be grouped by color.

sort-criteria-date.label: by creation date
sort-criteria-date.question: How to sort notes by creation date?
sort-criteria-date.answer: Go to Settings, check Order notes and select by creation date. Notes will be sorted from oldest to newest. If you prefer the newest at the beginning, check reverse order as well.

sort-criteria-datemod.label: by modification date
sort-criteria-datemod.question: How to sort notes by modification date?
sort-criteria-datemod.answer: Go to Settings, check Order notes and select by modification date. Notes will be sorted depending on the last date of their modification. If you prefer the last changed at the beginning, check reverse order as well.

sort-criteria-calendarDate.label: by calendar date
sort-criteria-calendarDate.question: How to sort notes by calendar date?
sort-criteria-calendarDate.answer: Go to Settings, check Order notes and select by calendar date. Notes will be sorted by the date they are included in the calendar.

sort-criteria-alpha.label: alphabetically
sort-criteria-alpha.question: How to sort notes alphabetically?
sort-criteria-alpha.answer: Go to Settings, check Order notes and select alphabetically. Notes will be sorted alphabetically, depending on their title from A to Z and from A to Я.

start-board-select.label: Start Board:
start-board-select.question: How to choose which board to show on startup?
start-board-select.answer: Go to Settings and select a board from Start Board. This board will be shown automatically every time you open the application.

use-google-db-checkbox.label: Google Drive:
use-google-db-checkbox.question: What does the Google Drive setting do?
use-google-db-checkbox.answer: By default, this setting is enabled, together with Database and on first open the application loads notes from Google Drive and creates a local database for faster access. Every subsequent time you open the program, it only checks for new and changed notes. If you want all notes to always be read from Google Drive uncheck Database.

use-indexeddb-checkbox.label: Database:
use-indexeddb-checkbox.question: What does the Database setting do?
use-indexeddb-checkbox.answer: By default, this setting is enabled and after initial loading notes are stored in the browser's local database for fast access. This allows shortening the loading time and working without internet if necessary. If you use only Database for loading, click the Mode button and the new and changed notes will be loaded from Google Drive.

guide-1.question: What do you see on the main screen and why is it important?
guide-1.answer: When the number of boards is large and they are not displayed on the screen, this button allows you to call the popup window with all the boards. On the tablet or phone screen, the button is floating and can be placed in a convenient place. On a mobile device, you can switch to the next or previous board by swiping right or left. Tap the button for more information:

1.text: The number and size of notes on the screen can be changed from Settings → Zoom.

2.text: Once changed, the size is saved and applied to all notes. Close the note by clicking the X button or anywhere outside it. Clicking on the note opens it. The size of the opened note can be changed by dragging the bottom right angle.

3.text: By default, the note is opened for preview with a graphic background resembling old paper. If you want to see the color of the note, you can disable the background.

4.text: For searching information, the search field is used. To learn more about the search options, open the chat window and type search.

5.text: At the bottom of the screen, status messages appear. If you click the message, it will disappear immediately.

1.text:
Hello!
👋 I'm your assistant, always ready to help.

2.text: A few quick tips before we start.

3.text: Click on me, or press Enter or Space, and I’ll hop to the next step. Use Ctrl‑click to stop the explanation.

4.text: Click the speech bubble to give yourself time to read it. When you're ready, continue using the button in the top corner.

5.text: This icon floats, and you can move it wherever you like. Use Ctrl‑click to make it semi‑transparent.

6.text: I don’t have Instagram yet, so I’ll drop in some of my photos from time to time. If you click the X on a photo without opening it, you won’t see my photos on this board anymore. In Settings, you can hide me completely — and that hides all my photos too.

7.text: Click the title and I’ll replay my introduction.

assistant-2.question: What’s good to know while using the chat window?
assistant-2.answer:
The chat window lets you search for information with the help of the assistant. It can answer your questions, help with tasks, and explain interface elements. Always check the exact question the assistant is responding to (shown at the beginning of its answer), because it’s generated from what you wrote but often doesn’t match your wording exactly. If the answer doesn’t contain what you need, try rephrasing your question.
Alongside the standard features, the chat window also includes some handy extras for your convenience. To explore them, press the button:

1.text: No need to write long questions — I understand even a single word. Try typing just search.

2.text: History — the last questions I answered can also be shown by sending a space instead of ?.

3.text: If you press this button without typing anything, the chat window will close.

4.text: If you click the text of your last question, it will be placed in the editing field.

5.text: From here you can open all the questions I can answer. You can also quickly search through the list by typing something in the field below.

note.question: What additional functions do notes have on the board?
note.answer:
If the note contains an image or video as an attachment, you can open it for preview by clicking the icon at the bottom of the note.

The image can stay open, and with a Ctrl‑click on the board name you can open or close all images in that board.

1.text: There are two special boards — With photos and With video, which display all notes containing an image or video in one place. You can enable them from Settings.

modes.question: What modes of operation are available?
modes.answer: Press Show me to have them explained. You can change them in Settings > Data loading.

1.text:
Here you will see where your notes are loaded from. The following options are available:

Database and Google Drive
Google Drive only
Database only

2.text: The main mode of operation uses a local database in the browser, which is updated with new and edited notes from Google Drive. This approach ensures optimal performance.

3.text: On first launch, all notes are downloaded from Google Drive and stored in a local browser database (cache).

4.text: Every subsequent load is done directly from this database, with a check to download only the new and modified notes. This greatly speeds up the process.

5.text: The fastest way is to use Database-only mode. Notes load instantly, and clicking the icon allows you to check for new or updated notes in Google Drive whenever needed.

6.text:
IMPORTANT!
Deleting a note or even the entire database doesn’t affect anything in Google Drive. The database and all notes can always be restored from what’s stored there.

search-notes.question: How do I search within the notes?
search-notes.answer: Use the search field at the top of the page:

1.text: Searches can be saved for quick access (the number of saved searches — from 1 to 20 — is set in the settings).

2.text: The first line shows the text of your most recent search — it updates with every new search.

3.text: The next lines show the saved searches — they remain unchanged.

organize-notes.question: How can I organize my notes?
organize-notes.answer: You can use Settings > Order notes to arrange them by date, color, alphabetical order, and other criteria.

calendar-view.question: How do I use the calendar?
calendar-view.answer: Click the Calendar button in the board names menu. The calendar displays all notes for which you have set a date. You can switch between monthly and weekly view. If you click a date in the monthly view, the weekly calendar will open, showing the week that contains the selected date.

offline-mode.question: Can I work offline?
offline-mode.answer: Yes! After the initial loading, you can disable Google Drive in Settings and work solely with the local database. This gives you full offline access to your notes. To refresh the data, click the Mode button.
